label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (sql-injection) is a True Positive. The sink at line 25 constructs a SQL query using 'param', which originates from user input via request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although a regex validation (^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$) is applied, it only restricts the character set of the input to resemble a valid identifier. It does not whitelist specific allowed table names. Consequently, an attacker can supply a valid-looking table name (e.g., 'users') to access sensitive data, constituting a SQL Injection vulnerability via dynamic schema manipulation.

evidence.note: User input 'param' flows into SQL construction at line 25 despite regex validation which only restricts charsets, not allowed table names.
